open.title: Give your agent a browser
open.body: Your session can open a page right inside lich. Right-click your session and pick Browser.
open.hint: Pick Browser in your session's menu to continue

pane.title: You and your agent see the same page
pane.body: Your agent drives this page with its browser tools, so ask it things like "open localhost:3000 and check the login". You can click and type here too.

pick.title: Point at the page
pick.body: Instead of describing where something is, leave a note right on it.
pick.hint: Click Leave notes on the page to continue

note.title: Leave a note
note.body: Click any element on the page, write what should change, and press Add note.

send.title: Send your notes
send.body: Your notes wait here. Send types all of them into your session as one message, each one naming the element it is about.
